Utpaladeva,_Utpala
of Kashmir; son of Udayākara, disciple of Somānanda, guru of Lakṣmaṇagupta an. grand-preceptor of Abhinavagupta; end of the 9th an. first half of the 10th cent.; teacher also of Rāmakaṇṭha (a. of Vyomavyāpistava), Adyar; mentioned a. preceptor by Maheśvaratejānandanātha in his Ānandakalpalatikā,

.
--Ajaḍapramātṛsiddhi. See NCC. I. p. 63.
Part of his Siddhitrayī, ptd. in Kas. Texts 34, 1921.
--Īśvarapratyabhijñākārikā(-sūtra). See above, p. 275b. 276a.
--C. on above, Madhyapratyabhijñā or Ṭīkā. See above, p. 276a.
--C. on above, Laghupratyabhijñā or Vṛtti. See above, p. 276a.
--Īśvarasiddhi with Vṛtti. See above p. 278. Part of his Siddhitrayī.
--Parameśvarastotrāvalī. Report XXX. same a. Stotrāvalī below ?
--Śivadṛṣṭivṛtti.
Written for his son Vibhramākara an. a classmate Padmānanda.
Ed.. Kas. Texts 56. 1934.
--Sambandhasiddhi with Vṛtti. Part of his Siddhitrayī.
--Stotrāvalī or Śivastotrāvalī.
Pt.. Chowkhambā, Banaras 1902-3. [Page317-b]
--[Bhāvopahārastotra of Utpala cited in Ratnakaṇṭha's C. on Jagaddhara's Stutikusumāñjali 19. 16 (K.

) is only stotra 13 (called Saṅgraha, not Bhāvopahāra), verse 17 in the Stotrāvalī above.].
--verses on Śiva composed by him are in a codex along with Śārikānityapūjāpaddhati (RASB. VIII.

). The verse extracted here is not in the collection Śivastotrāvalī noted above.
--Q. on music in the Abhinavabhāratī. C.. JOR. Madras

Utpalaparimala
name of a C. on Bṛhatsaṁhitā of Varāhamihira, by Yogin or Yogīśvara, son of Kumāra of Vārṣagaṇya kula an. pupil of Nirupamabodha an. who wrote when the Hoysala King Narasiṁha was in Śrīraṅgam. In one set of mss. (
), a. add. verse is found mentioning the a. a. Bhāskara of Naidhruvakāśyapakula. Completed in A.

-6.
See also J. of the Sri Venk. Ori. Inst., Tirupati, II. i. p.. 49-55.

Utpalala(utpala_?)parimala
jy. by Govinda Bhaṭṭa (?) Rice 28.

Utpalamālā
lex.
--C. Dīpikā by Govindapāda.
Q. in Amarakhaṇḍana of Śrīharṣa. Mentioned in the Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana a C. by Kallolabhaṭṭācārya on his grandfather Sujana's lex., Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. See JOR. Madras. V. p.. 11, 12, 23, 25; Amaramaṇḍana edn., Deccan College, Poona, 1949, Intro., [Page318-a. p.. 8, 9, an. Adyar Library Bulletin VII. p. 41. Mss. notes.

Utpalamālikā

Utpalamālinī

, by Nārāyaṇa Vidyāvinoda on same (JOR., Madras

Utpalarāja
name of the Paramāra King Muñja alias Vākpatirāja of Mālwa, uncle an. predecessor of Bhoja. Verses of his q. in Anthologies, an. Alaṁkāra works, e.g. Au. v.. carcā 16; Daśarūpakāvaloka
; Skm. p.. 64, 162, 316; (other verses under the name Muñja); Śp. 1017.

Utpala_Vaiṣṇava
of Kashmir, son of Trivikrama of Nārāyaṇasthāna; refers to an. quotes from the maternal grandfather of his father, Mahābala; called ‘Vaiṣṇava’ to distinguish him from the Kashmirian Śaiva teacher Utpaladeva.
--Bhogamokṣapradīpikā. Q. in the next, (twice) (p.. 14b. 22a-b, BORI. ms. 512 of 1875-76; p. 49, Viz. Skt. Ser. edn.).
--Spandapradīpikā. Ms.

, Banares 1898.
Without mentioning the name, he q. some other text of his too on p.. 17b-18a, 24b (mayaiva coktaM kvApi).

Utpalaśānti
to ward off the evil of the growth of mushrooms in a house-compound.

Utpala(tpāta_?)śānti
said to be from the Utpalaparimala.

Utpalāraṇyamāhātmya
from the Brahma Saṁhitā of the Skandapurāṇa.

Utpalinī
lex.
by Vyāḍi acc. to Hārāvalī, Kāvyakalpalatāvṛtti etc. See p.. xi-xii, Intro., Kalpadrukośa, GOS. XLII, Vol. I. Widely q. in C.s on Amarakośa an. Kāvyas, an. used in other lex.s.
E.g. see the following C.s on Amarakośa: by Rāyamakuṭa (Adyar D.
b); mentioned in the following lex.s.,--in Puruṣottama's Hārāvali (Adyar D.
); in Medinī; in Śivadatta's C. on his Śivakośa (Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His..

a, 126a); Śivarāma, Śarvacandra etc. on Vāsavadattā (Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p.. 268, 270-3 an.

Utprabhātīya_Vallabha
(Utprabhātīya is surname). of Kūrmācala; father of Harivallabha (C. on Vyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāra of Koṇḍabhaṭṭa).
--Vinodamañjarī. vedānta.

Utprekṣāvallabha
poet. real name Gokula a. stated in his Sundarīśataka; from his Bhikṣāṭanakāvya, he appears to have been known also a. Śivabhaktadāsa.
--Bhikṣāṭanakāvya.
Pt.. K. M.

. Several verses from here in Smv.
--Sundarīśataka, written a. the instance of King Madana.
Pt.. K. M.

Utprekṣitavallabha
name of the a. Mādhava, son of Maṇḍala Bhaṭṭa, younger brother of ‘Paṇḍitarāja’ an. patronised by Kṛṣṇadāsa of Mihiravaṁśa.
--Saptaśatī (in the style of Govardhana's Āryāsaptaśatī). Ms., Bikaner. See here verse 35, Intro. Composed in A.
. Mentions Govinda Bhaṭṭa alias Akbarīyakālidāsa. J. of the Tanjore Sar. Mah. Lib.
